reasons.action: The brief explicitly requests the action of a bricklayer laying a course, one brick per hit; with no visual reference, the action is entirely request-governed.
reasons.medium: There is no visual reference. The only attached asset is an audio beat reference, which does not establish a visual medium, so the medium defaults to Live-action, cinematic.
reasons.wardrobe: No visual reference supplies wardrobe, and the request does not specify clothing. Wardrobe therefore remains request-governed rather than reference-governed.
reasons.lighting: No visual reference or explicit lighting instruction is present. Lighting is request-governed and follows the default cinematic treatment.
reasons.framing: The explicit 16:9 aspect and 8-second duration are canvas/timing settings, not framing instructions. With no visual reference, framing remains request-governed.
reasons.palette: No visual reference supplies a palette, and no explicit palette is requested. Palette is therefore request-governed under the default live-action cinematic look.
